hints.content: We have two tapes that are the same length. Let's start by writing an expression for the length of each tape.

The top tape has two parts, one with a length of $15$ units and the other with a length of $x$ units.

The total length of the top tape is $15+x$ units.

The bottom tape has a length of $23$ units.

So, the tape diagram shows us $15+x=23$.

The section labeled $x$ is $15$ units shorter than the $23$ unit long tape.

$x=23-15={}?$
